notes.text:
Bigger update! Has quite the fixes and new implementations which makes everything a lot more stable:
## New Stuff
- Swap traps have been added. When triggered your current active and hold minos swap without input.
- The text log now supports colors like a usual archipelago text client
- An experimental prevention to the data package changed issue
- Your area score now gets saved between stages of the same area for Ranksanity. You will see the current total score after placing your first mino on a stage of the same area (the score will get reset if you go to a different area or replay one of the stages)
- "Bonus points" and "Zone charge bonus" now do something in-game. Bonus points grants 1000 points. Zone charge bonus increases your zone charge by a quarter
- New option to set how zone locations are obtained

## Changes
- Decreased trap chance from 25% to 12.5%
- Decreased some trap durations:
- - Broken mino traps now lasts 10 seconds instead of 15
- - Hold traps now last 15 seconds instead of 30
- - Ghost piece traps now last 20 seconds instead of 30
- - Queue traps now last 15 seconds instead of 30
- Removed combo back-to-back trick locations
- Changed most trick location requirements to lower values
- - T-spins from 10 to 4
- - Back-to-backs from 10 to 3
- - Tetris clears from 15 to 6
- - Combos from 8 to 4
- B ranks now require the zone mechanic
- Bump area rank's amount of stages unlocked to achieve
- Change option names with clearer names and descriptions
- Changes to the docs + made a step-by-step ue4ss install guide if their guide is too confusing
- The connection menu now displays the mod version
- Speed trap now adapts to difficulty as it was just too mean:
- - On easy, sets the speed to 15
- - On normal, sets the speed to 20
- - On expert, sets the speed to M13 (the original behaviour lol)

## Fixes
- Metamorphosis and the zone are, for *real*, now properly locked and without errors
- Fixed issue in where you randomly stopped getting rank checks until reconnection
- Ghost piece traps can now be triggered
- Playlist modes now properly send their mode clear location
- Fix a bug that would give double the amount of stage completions in the game
- The Story mode stage selection now prevents selection of locked levels better without breaking the cursor
- The connection menu no longer hides when going around menus, like the options, on the main menu
- Ranksanity is now considered on rule creation, which would prevent generation if false
- Made sure that some player options are actually used on generation

Find the setup guide [here!](https://github.com/ZatchyBeeps/Archipelago-TEC/blob/main/worlds/tetriseffect/docs/setup_en.md)
Please continue telling me about any errors you find please! Happy randomizing!
